01 / CONTROL

Your GPU. Your choice.

Enable or disable GPU acceleration in Preferences → Performance. The same setting follows you into the CLI, Python, and MCP.

02 / VISIBILITY

Know what’s running.

Check your adapter and backend, or run the built-in GPU self-test from the Help menu or with arclight gpu --check.

Foundation release · 0.12.0 GPU setup, controls, and diagnostics are available. Node evaluation still runs on the CPU in this release; accelerated node and rendering paths are the next milestones.

01 / COMPOSITING ENGINE

Built for the whole shot

The pipeline makes the choices a compositor should make, everywhere, so your edges stay clean.

32bit

Float RGBA

Every pixel, every node. Values above 1.0 survive until you decide otherwise.

linear

Linear light

sRGB encode/decode only at the 8-bit boundary. Light adds the way light adds.

premult

Associated alpha

Premultiplied throughout — blurs and merges fade cleanly with no dark fringing.

DAG

Cached graph

Each node cached by a hash of op, params and inputs. Edit one; only downstream re-renders.

∞cores

Parallel

Per-pixel work spread across every core with Rayon; a frame cache reuses results as you scrub.

200undo

Safe to explore

Every graph edit is undoable. A whole slider drag is one step.

03 / NODE LIBRARY

The arsenal

Every node ships with generated property panels, keyframes on every numeric param, and optional masks.

04 / CREATIVE TOOLKIT

One graph. More possibilities.

The big set pieces — each one wired into the same graph, the same undo history, the same scripting API.

05 / SCRIPTING & AUTOMATION

Creative control, programmable.

Python, MCP for AI agents, native plugins and live formulas all drive one engine API. Scripts can even attach to the running app — their edits land in your undo history.

06 / MEDIA & FORMATS

Pipeline-ready I/O

In

  • EXR 32-bit float, every pass as a layer, data windows
  • DPX 8/10/12/16-bit & float, log → linear via Cineon
  • TIFF · TGA · WebP · PNG · JPEG · HDR
  • Video mp4 · mov · mkv · mxf · webm (via ffmpeg, 10-bit+ kept at 16-bit)
  • Sequences drop one frame, get shot.####.exr
  • 3D Alembic .abc · splats .ply .splat .spz

Out

  • ProRes 422 HQ · 4444 + alpha
  • DNxHR HQX · 444 (10-bit)
  • HEVC · AV1 10-bit · H.264 · VP9 (+ alpha)
  • DPX 10-bit log, video, or 32-bit float
  • EXR with depth, P, N, uv, motion, mattes, diffuse…
  • Audio carried through to .mov / .mp4 in sync
07 / ROADMAP

The next chapter

Where the engine goes next. Roadmap items are planned, not included in the current beta.

  1. GPU node evaluation & rendering — building on the 0.12 foundation, including a GPU splat path
  2. Tiled / ROI processing for very large images
  3. Python plugins — custom nodes written in Python
  4. USD / Hydra
  5. Distro packages (deb / rpm / AUR) and notarized macOS builds
  6. Windows — the engine and GUI already cross-compile
08 / GET ARCLIGHTVFX

Join the beta

Linux x86_64 tarball, a universal macOS DMG (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Python wheels. Choose an available build from the release list; replace VERSION below with its version. Video I/O needs ffmpeg on your PATH.

$ arclight-gui comp.json
$ pip install arclt-VERSION-cp310-abi3-*.whl
